opening.argument: The video provides ordinary, step-by-step instruction for getting started with Office 365 on an iPad or iPhone: search the App Store, install Word or another Office application, and sign in with the same account used to activate an existing subscription. The on-screen sign-in forms and subsequent “You're All Set” screens show a routine setup process leading to the option to create and edit documents. The external support link is presented as a help resource, while its behavior is not assessed. The content therefore explains an operational technology workflow rather than promising an unbounded result or documenting an outcome beyond setup.

citations.quote: today we're going to help you get started using Office 365 on your iPad or iPhone.
First, go to the App Store and search for Office. In this example, we'll install Word, but you'll follow the same steps for every app.
You should sign in with the same logging you used when you activated your Office 365 subscription.
